name: flutter-dart
description: A strict analyzer: strict casts, inference, and raw types; TODO/FIXME/HACK as errors; package imports only; no dynamic calls, print, or discarded futures. Plus feature import boundaries and ARB translation checks through the agnostic pack.

tools.name: flutter
tools.why: flutter analyze and flutter test; pure Dart packages can use dart analyze

tools.name: flutter_lints
tools.why: dev dependency the analysis_options include needs

merge.how: Copy the rules that match the app's folder layout and adjust the globs. They need always_use_package_imports, which analysis_options.yaml enables.
Point source at the template ARB file named by l10n.yaml, then add "locale-keys" with install-pack.mjs flutter-dart --with or by adding the agnostic optional check.

baseline: The analyzer has no baseline file. Add `// ignore_for_file: <rule>, team-kit baseline` at the top of each file with existing violations, then add {"id": "dart-baseline", "pattern": "team-kit baseline", "files": ["*.dart"]} to .agents/ratchet.json and run ratchet.mjs update.
